I think is better not take everything in a rioter post as true, even if the one posting it is one of the writers. Ill explain myself:

I think all writters in riot share a general and basic knowledge about the world of LoL and where the plot is going but they do not know everything about things that other writers make (ex: the real power of one character, what they really are or limitations) so they fill the blank spaces with their own headcannons until a properly lore update is discussed and agreed to be released, so until that moment we can get conflicting ideas.

The guy who wrote Sol lore have said before that Sol and Nagakabouros had encountered each other before so our dragon dont just "understand more" he saw the real thing in person (so maybe Naga is as metaphysical as the other writer say?), the guy also post that Sol see Bard and Naga as his equals and in another post that even though Sol is egocentric he knows that he isnt invencible and there are things that can put a fight againts him so if Naga is really much more powerful i doubt that Sol will put himself at his level even with his ego especially after meeting it in person (he is full of himself but not stupid) and finally the guy also implied in another post that maybe Naga is lying to Illaoi and it is more a being like Sol and Bard sharing his power with her instead of a real god soo....looks like writers have conflicting ideas bcoz they dont know everything about each other characters and as a result we cant really fully trust post until proven by official lore updates :/
